proof_body:
by
  have h : ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ 3 = ((2 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  refine irrational_nrt_of_notint_nrt 3 2 h ?_ (by norm_num)
  rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
  rw [hy] at h
  have hz : y ^ 3 = 2 := by exact_mod_cast h
  have h1 : y < 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y), sq_nonneg (y + 1)]
  have h2 : -2 < y := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y), sq_nonneg (y - 1)]
  interval_cases y <;> omega
